title: Deployment-to-Runtime Proof Audit
objective: Prove that Flora is running the repository implementation expected by the Chief Architect and expose any mismatch between declared change, deployed source, loaded runtime and active route behaviour.
implementation_summary: Made Canonical Factual Projection carry its deterministic Enterprise synthesis as the governed derivative consumed by the executive route.
Made Organisation Overview and Advanced Inspection consume that same canonical synthesis rather than independently rebuilding or merely describing it.
Preserved source Profile absence, factual gaps, candidate governance, and the existing operational acceptance decision.
expected_visible_outcomes: The Import screen visibly answers AM I TESTING THE EXPECTED CODE?
The expected factual-synthesis implementation is shown as present, loaded, connected and exercised where determinable.
Advanced Inspection provides the detailed deployment-to-runtime trace.
unchanged_areas: Protected: 308 Relationship candidates; working Enterprise identity lineage and associations; 13 Programmes; 17 Opportunities; factual dimension isolation; candidate governance.
required_test_steps: Open Import Twin and confirm functional readiness is independent of optional deployment metadata.
Open Advanced Inspection and confirm the source, synthesis, executive-consumption and rendered states in ENTERPRISE FACTUAL SYNTHESIS TRACE.
Open the Enterprise list and all six TEL-001 Enterprise dossiers.
Confirm 308 Relationships, 13 Programmes, 17 Opportunities and exact Enterprise associations remain reconciled.
fresh_import_policy: No fresh import is required: this change adds read-only diagnostics and provenance only.
known_limitations: Enterprise Economics and Leadership / Governance are architectural intent not implemented as independent TEL-001 runtime dimensions.
Industry/domain remains Not established because TEL-001 Enterprise candidates carry no explicit semantic domain and Twin membership is not treated as proof.
